question_en: Which other specs do CRs modifying TS 38.214 most often ripple into, and how many CRs each?
original_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(mainSpec:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) MATCH (cr)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(otherSpec:Spec) WHERE mainSpec <> otherSpec RETURN mainSpec.specNumber AS modifiedSpec, otherSpec.specNumber AS affectedSpec, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC
reference_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'})
MATCH (cr)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(other:Spec)
WHERE other.specNumber IS NOT NULL AND other.specNumber <> '38.214'
RETURN other.specNumber AS affectedSpec, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount
ORDER BY crCount DESC, affectedSpec ASC

required_fields.name: crCount
required_fields.source_column_or_expression: count(DISTINCT cr) per recorded other.specNumber across all three typed AFFECTS roles
